description: Public Z contouring settings: the enabled flag gates the no-alternation option and minimum slice-plane offset while sparse infill remains finite and positive.

mutants.description: Remove the zaa_enabled gate from the fill flag. The disabled-plus-dont-alternate row must remain identical to disabled-plus-alternating.
Bypass the no-alternation flag while retaining a valid layer-id guard. The enabled fixed row must remain one direction across layers.

Require a previously active ZAA region before selecting the slice offset, which disables the first and only region in the fixture. The low and high enabled minimum-Z rows must retain their distinct later-layer offsets.
